rationale: The video moves from a provocative GPT-4 hook through Qwen2 family identity, selected Llama 3 benchmark tables, social proof, edited prompt/output examples, and a personal resource CTA. The protocol therefore preserves exact visible model identities, claim/evidence/condition/limit relations, prompt–output state changes, the missing GPT-4 matched baseline, SRT/burned-caption conflicts, and the black-gap/late-card closing structure.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: spoken_or_visible_product_identity
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: The five-size family listing (including 57B-A14B), four-column specification card, 72B and 7B benchmark tables, demo checkpoint, Llama 3, GPT-4, and OpenAI are not interchangeable identities.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: claim_and_provenance
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: The central superiority and recommendation statements are author claims, not externally verified facts.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: comparison_target_and_visible_baseline
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: Visible tables mainly compare Qwen2 to Llama 3/other open models while the hook and recommendation invoke GPT-4.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: test_task_prompt_action_output
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: Edited UI shows a joke interaction, a Fibonacci-code request/response, and a side-by-side long-form response screen.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: execution_and_scoring_status
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: Code execution, output scoring, matched prompts, latency, and continuity are decision-relevant but may be absent.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: model_specification
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: The 0.5B–72B family and 72B/128K claim must remain scoped to visible/spoken configurations.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: benchmark_rows_columns_conditions_limits
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: The 72B and 7B comparison tables require separate identities, and the 72B table itself contains Llama 3 wins on MBPP (82.3 > 80.2) and GSM8K (93.0 > 91.1), directly contradicting universal superiority; HumanEval in the 7B table is 79.9/62.2/71.8, not an additional Llama win.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: bounded_non_speech_audio_role
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: Audio must receive semantic inspection, not only amplitude inspection: 0–63.7 seconds contains recurrent music beneath speech, a ding-like effect is localized to 22–24 seconds, and 63.689 seconds onward is silent at the stated threshold.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: social_proof_identity_text_scale_limit
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: Brief posts and developer montage can be overread as broad adoption proof.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: recommendation_conditions_and_counterexamples
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: Free/open status does not establish zero deployment cost or universal task superiority.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: cta_action_and_unknown_boundaries
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: The resource package's contents, delivery, license, provenance, security, and requirements are unstated.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: carrier_conflict
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: Verbatim SRT contains consequential ASR errors that burned captions/UI clarify.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: edited_chronology_and_continuity_limit
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: Montage order is not proof of a continuous live run; late-card tail must be retained.

knowledgeUnitFields.name: opening_to_closing_payoff
knowledgeUnitFields.reason: The GPT-4 hook ends not in a matched test but in a comment CTA and repeated Qwen2 specification card.

stoppingRules: Stop only after every critical question is answered or explicitly preserved as unknown with bounded evidence scope.
Stop only after exact Qwen2 family/72B/Instruct/demo identities are separated wherever visible or stated.
Stop only after every benchmark and UI example is captured with its visible comparison target and missing methodology/execution conditions.
Stop only after the full timeline is inspected for a matched GPT-4 baseline and any absence claim is scoped to 0–86.567 seconds and relevant UI/table/audio carriers.
Stop only after the Fibonacci prompt/output sequence and side-by-side response UI have before/during/after or dense UI evidence, with code execution/scoring unknown unless shown.
Stop only after SRT/burned-caption conflicts are preserved rather than silently corrected.
Stop only after the social-proof montage has legible identities/text captured and adoption scale remains unknown where unproved.
Stop only after the CTA package contents, access route, license, security, system, account, price, and region boundaries are either observed or explicitly unknown.
Stop only after the black tail and late Qwen2 card are represented in the closing relation rather than dropped.
Stop only after audio presence/non-speech channel handling is explicit and technical shot segments are not upgraded to edit/scene counts.
Stop only after bounded semantic audio inspection identifies accepted non-speech roles, rejects unstable labels, and registers its time windows and limitations as evidence.
Stop only after the five-size family listing including 57B-A14B is reconciled with the later four-column card.
Stop only after the 72B and 7B benchmark tables remain separate and MBPP/GSM8K Llama 3 wins are represented as direct counterexamples; do not misread 7B-table HumanEval 62.2 as 82.2.
Stop only after every available carrier is inspected or explicitly excluded with reason and no whole carrier/meaning/relation remains unchecked.
